BL-1124 — Property-suite fixtures must never mutate shared main refs or core.bare
What it solves: Source: .swarmforge/operator/INTAKE-BL-570-property-suite-fixture-mutated-shared-main.md Evidence: backlog/evidence/BL-570-coder-land-20260824.md. Related done BL-570 (drift guard) — this is the isolation follow-up the land exposed. Companion critical guard: BL-1123.
Approval context: Fixtures invoked by npm run test:properties / check_property_suite_drift.sh must use isolated git dirs only — never rename or advance shared main / role branch refs on the live repo, and must leave core.bare=false. Recovery that resets main to origin/main when local is ahead is also out of policy. …
BL-1124 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1124" (or "reject BL-1124 <reason>") to act.
